name: moonstage
description: Moonstage: an open-source chat stage for character cards, with HarperHarbor authentication and SillyTavern / MMD compatibility

paragraphs: Moonstage is the open chat stage for HarperHarbor character cards: the page where a card is played. It renders SillyTavern-style and MMD-style cards (regex display rules, author CSS and scripts, HUD panels, multiple greetings, prologues) and talks only to the public /open/v1 API. It hosts no cards and runs no models.
Moonstage is maintained by Hearthroom. The standalone playground uses HarperHarbor for authorization, agent configurations and conversations.
features: src/pages/canvas/ — the chat stage: message rendering, author display rules, panels,
src/pages/login/, src/pages/oauth/ — OAuth sign-in against HarperHarbor.
src/pages/play/ — entry route: open a card by id.
docs/open-api-v1.md — the frozen API contract this client depends on.
docs/trust-model.md — why author-provided HTML, CSS and scripts run as-is.
